scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Riffle presents collaborative music creation from recorded everyday material through editing, sharing and remixing.
explains_well: One kitchen-inspired project passes between people, with named cursors linking software and live action.
unclear: Music quality and how the recorded kitchen material becomes the final track cannot be assessed without hearing it.
scenario: Record kitchen material, build a song with collaborators and share it for remixing.
product_clear_basis: A kitchen foley waveform and music workspace make the earlier phone recording useful in a concrete creation workflow.
